title: pilosella × cinerea
intro: Pilosella × cinerea, commonly known as the Cinereous Mouse-ear Hawkweed, is a rare and hybrid plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella × cinerea are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
